expectations.text: States the August 2026 change: BIS reversed its 2013 ECR position — such UAVs now classify in 9A610.a (with MT language mirroring 9A012)
expectations.evidence: Contradicts ground truth: "military UAVs not described on the USML classify in the 600-series as 9A012.a" — the 2026 rule places them in 9A610.a, not 9A012.a

expectations.text: Notes less-sensitive parts/components/accessories go to new 9A610.y.33
expectations.evidence: "Parts, components, and accessories... classify separately under the newly created 9A610.y.33"

expectations.text: Mentions license exception STA availability to Country Group A:5 where the UAV cannot deliver ≥500 kg payload to ≥300 km (§740.20(g) conditions)
expectations.evidence: "STA... may be available for shipments to Country Group A:5... only where the UAV cannot deliver at least 500 kg of payload to at least 300 km range"

expectations.text: Applies the order of review: USML Category VIII first (CJ if unclear), then CCL
expectations.evidence: "The Order of Review (§ 732.3) requires checking the USML first... the safer move... is a Commodity Jurisdiction (CJ) request to DDTC"

expectations.text: Notes 3A611.a no longer applies to these UAVs after the rule
expectations.evidence: No mention that 3A611.a no longer applies to these UAVs after the rule
